exercises.why: **прочитали** — прочита́ть (perfective): to read, to read through; to recite. Wiktionary: про- + чита́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **считаетесь** — счита́ться (imperfective): to settle accounts (with), to consider, to take into consideration, to reckon (with); (impersonal, imperfective only) to be considered / reputed (someone), to be, to pass (for). Wiktionary: счита́ть + -ся.
